name: Segment Tracing with Local Lipschitz Bounds
aliases: Segment Tracing Using Local Lipschitz Bounds
definition: A ray marching algorithm that computes a local Lipschitz bound λ(e) for each segment e to determine the step size, reducing field function queries compared to global bounds.
summary: Segment Tracing with Local Lipschitz Bounds is a ray marching algorithm that computes local Lipschitz bounds for adaptive step sizes, rigorously guaranteeing no surface intersections are skipped under complex non-linear warping.
